title: Vaporize WCode canonical Pkl resource lifecycle

requirements.requirement: Use project.pkl, amending the canonical project-definition module, as the source of application-resource intent.
Model target resources independently from Xcode source build phases with path, copy or process mode, optional destination, includes, excludes, and optionality.
Select one explicit target and platform before planning resources; target or platform ambiguity fails closed.
Confine source paths to the package root and destination paths to a namespaced WCode resource root, refusing traversal and collisions before publication.
Perform resource planning, staging, install copying, and launch composition in Swift services without invoking PowerShell or accepting a lifecycle script callback.

Keep Package.swift Bundle.module resources and Pkl application-shell resources distinct. Installation copies only the executable, the canonical Pkl resource root, and exact runtime artifact names explicitly admitted by the caller; it never infers a product closure by sweeping a shared build-products directory.
Return typed per-resource outcomes suitable for declaration, evaluation, materialization, bundle-inventory, and runtime receipts.
Reject unsupported process or filter semantics rather than silently degrading to copy or arbitrary script execution.

Continue generating macOS .xcodeproj output from the same canonical project.pkl by projecting portable copy resources into PBX Resources phases without changing existing Xcode-specific source build-phase behavior. PBX world-state generation and native macOS xcodebuild are separate evidence lanes; mixed-platform target selection remains gated by its owning bug bead.

Validate the WCode product as one safe Windows filename component, validate project and resource intent before compilation, and confine every derived resource path beneath the selected build-products directory.

Confine application installation to a strict descendant of the admitted per-user Programs root. Force reinstall may replace only that bounded destination and may not target an arbitrary filesystem directory.
Reserve every WCODE_ environment key for the lifecycle service and reject caller attempts to override contract state.
The explicit wcode command authority is the feature-selection gate. No existing SwiftPM or Xcode command silently enters this lifecycle.
